title: jams engine scene list, format v1

$schema.description: The scene-list JSON Schema this file follows.

start.description: The scene a new game starts in: a listed scene that isn't a sublevel.

title.description: What menus and the editor's picker call it.

sublevel.description: Attached beside a main scene through `ctx.flow.attach`, never loaded alone.

scenes.description: Every scene flow may load or attach, in the order menus and the picker show them.

description: The project's scene list, at most one per project: the start scene and every scene flow may load, co-edited per entry.
